title: Measuring Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in LLMs: Empirical Evaluation on ID and OOD QA Tasks
reasoning: The paper is a technical empirical study focused on uncertainty estimation (aleatoric and epistemic) in Large Language Models. While it mentions 'epistemic' uncertainty, this is used in the statistical/machine learning context of model knowledge rather than philosophical or religious epistemology. There is no evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics.
